criteria.requirement: Use an explicit strict/error-accounting policy and actually consume/validate all relevant rows before an irreversible publication or under a real staged/transaction boundary. The header and valid row can be yielded before the bad row raises; constructing a strict view is not validation success and prior external side effects are not undone by iteration.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
